data.current_description:
**Why you'll use it**

This is the timetable endpoint. Use it to build a wall display, feed a teacher's app, drive attendance taking, or reconcile who was booked where.

**Before you send**

How far you can see depends on your plan, and this is the one place where a FREE key changes the results rather than refusing:

- **FREE** always returns a rolling window of today −6 to +6 days. A `filter[date]` cannot widen it; it can only narrow it further.
- **PAID** does real date-range querying: at most 3 years back, and any one `filter[date]` range may span at most a year. With no `filter[date]` at all you get everything from 3 years ago onwards, with no cap on future lessons.

On both plans, a lesson someone skipped and has not yet rebooked stays visible for 90 days regardless of the window, so nothing pending quietly falls off the end.

When you filter by a single student with `filter[customerId]`, that student's own `attendance`, `attendanceUpdated`, `pendingMakeup` and `makeUpToActivityIds` are copied to the top level of each lesson, so you do not have to dig through `customers` to find them. That only happens for one student at a time, because attendance is inherently per-student.

**Example queries**

- `?filter[date][gte]=2026-03-16&filter[date][lte]=2026-03-22&sort=date,startTime`  
  One week of the timetable, in the order you'd print it.
- `?filter[customerId]=9101&filter[date][gte]=2026-03-01`  
  One student's lessons from March onwards, with their attendance flattened onto each one.
- `?filter[pendingMakeup]=true`  
  Everyone who has skipped a lesson and still owes a make-up.
- `?filter[attendance]=A&filter[date]=2026-03-17`  
  Yesterday's absences, for a follow-up call list.
- `?include=staffs,facilities&filter[date]=2026-03-17&fields[activity]=name,startTime,endTime`  
  A room-and-teacher plan for one day, with nothing else in the payload.

**Related records you can pull in** (`?include=`)

- `center` — The centre the lesson belongs to, as `{id, name}`.
- `customers` — Every student booked into the lesson, with their attendance, payment and make-up state. A booking's `status` is one of `W` weekly, `B` fortnightly, `T` single, `M` make-up, `S` skipped, `J` just-skipped, `N` normal, `Q` quit, `D` quit and moved up, `I` temporarily quit. _(already included by default — asking again changes nothing.)_
- `staffs` — The teachers assigned to the lesson.
- `facilities` — The rooms or resources booked for it.

**Why you'll use it**

Send only the keys you want to change. Use `YYYY-MM-DD` for dates and `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss` for `startTime` / `endTime`, without a timezone offset. Two things behave specially:

- **`applyTo`** decides how far a change reaches through a repeating series: `ThisOnly` (the default) touches just this lesson, `Following` carries the change through the rest of the series.
